label: Tutorial: Home
description: Steps of the Tutorial button on the Home page (endpoint home.home). A step: target (CSS selector, empty = centred card), title, text (blank line = new paragraph, **bold**, `code`), roles (optional: anonymous, user, member, admin, perm:<key>), demo (rule / bundle: example shown when the target is missing, e.g. an empty list).

steps.title: Version and release notes
steps.text: The version this instance runs. Click it to read what changed in the latest release.

steps.title: Search everything
steps.text: Type a rule name, a CVE (CVE-2024-3400), an ATT&CK technique (T1059), a malware family or any word: Rulezet searches titles, descriptions and the rules' content, in every format. The examples typing themselves in the box show what you can try.

steps.title: Browse by format
steps.text: Each chip opens the rules of one format — YARA for files, Sigma for logs, Suricata and Zeek for network traffic, CRS for web servers, and more.

steps.title: Add a rule or build a bundle
steps.text:
**Add a rule**: share a detection rule (by hand, from Git, a zip, JSON or the YARA editor).

**Create a bundle**: group rules of any format around one subject.

**Why Rulezet?** explains the project.

steps.title: Join to contribute
steps.text: Browsing and downloading are open to everyone. To add rules, vote, comment or build bundles, create a free account.

steps.title: Rulezet in numbers
steps.text: Detection rules, bundles, ATT&CK techniques covered and CVEs covered on this instance. Each figure is a link: rules → the Rules Explorer, bundles → the bundle list, ATT&CK → the heatmap, CVEs → the response kits.

steps.title: How it works
steps.text: The three steps of Rulezet: **find** a rule, **check** it (quality score, votes, tests, discussion), then **use** it (download, bundle, deploy).

steps.title: Live activity
steps.text: What is happening right now: the latest rules added and updated, as they arrive.

steps.title: Insights
steps.text: Charts of the instance: rules per format, most active sources, new rules over time. Pick a chart on the left; it loads when you open it.

steps.title: From the blog
steps.text: The latest posts: releases, CVE write-ups and articles. The full list is in Community → Blog.
